44521.commentary: (SNa) palimajjeyyā'ti sodheyya. (SNt) palimajjeyyā'ti allakaraṇavasena parito pāḷiṃ bandheyya. tathā karonto yasmā ca tattha tiṇagacch'ādīnaṃ mūlasantānaggahaṇena taṃ ṭhānaṃ sodheti nāma, tasmā vuttaṃ sodheyyā'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, taruṇo rukkho. tassa puriso kālena kālaṃ mūlāni palimajjeyya kālena kālaṃ paṃsuṃ dadeyya, kālena kālaṃ udakaṃ dadeyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, taruṇo rukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
vām'ūru saja maṃ bhadde, saja maṃ mandalocane, palissaja maṃ kalyāṇi, etaṃ me abhipatthitaṃ.
kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, alagaddo tassa purisassa hatthaṃ vā bāhaṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ bhogehi paliveṭheyya, atha kho so n'eva tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.

examples.text: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco yena seṭṭhibhariyā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā seṭṭhibhariyāya vikāraṃ sallakkhetvā seṭṭhibhariyaṃ etadavoca, pasatena, ayye, sappinā attho'ti. atha kho seṭṭhibhariyā jīvakassa komārabhaccassa pasataṃ sappiṃ dāpesi.

44585.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pasata
44585.notes: refers to drinking liquids out of the cupped palm of the hand

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsan'ti.

44586.notes: It refers to drinking liquids out of the cupped palm of the hand.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ, pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ, yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ, yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ, yadi vā hareṇukayūsan'ti.
kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.

44588.meaning1: fact of being praised; fact of being commended

44589.meaning1: highly praised; (or) praised by those who are praised
44589.commentary: (MNa) pasatthapasattho'ti sabbaguṇānaṃ uttaritarehi sabbalokapasatthehi attano guṇeh'eva pasattho, na tassa aññehi pasaṃsanakiccaṃ atthi… pasatthehi vā pasattho'ti'pi pasatthapasattho.

examples.text: uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ vacchāyano samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatī'ti. ko c'āhaṃ, bho, ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi? pasatthapasattho'va so bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānan'ti.

44590.meaning1: praised by the praised; exalted by the exalted

examples.text: ko c'āhaṃ, bho, ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi! pasatthappasattho'va so bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānan'ti. kiṃ pana bhavaṃ, piṅgiyānī, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe gotame evaṃ abhippasanno'ti?

evaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ca pasatthabhāv'ānurūpaṃ attano dhāraṇabalaṃ dassento sattānaṃ sotu'kamyataṃ janeti evaṃ me sutaṃ, tañ'ca kho atthato vā byañjanato vā anūnaman'adhikaṃ, evam'eva na aññathā daṭṭhabban'ti.

44592.meaning1: spotted antelope; Chital; Axis Deer; Axis axis
44592.commentary: (SNa) hatthayo pasadā migā'ti hatthino ca pasadamigā ca.

examples.text: haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca, hatthayo pasadā migā, sabbe sīhassa bhāyanti, n'atthi kāyasmiṃ tulyatā.
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukhamanveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.
sugandhaṃ sītalaṃ kappaṃ, pasannamadhuraṃ subhaṃ, pāṇīyam'etaṃ bhagavā, paṭigaṇhātu'm'uttama.

44594.meaning1: who has faith; who has confidence (in)

examples.text: mettāvihārī yo bhikkhu, pasanno buddhasāsane, adhigacche padaṃ santaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ.
rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
pāmojjabahulo bhikkhu, pasanno buddhasāsane, adhigacche padaṃ santaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ.
pañca uppalahatthāni, āveḷatthaṃ ahaṃsu me, tena buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

44596.meaning1: believer; who has faith; who has confidence (in)

examples.text: n'etaṃ, moghapurisa, appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya, pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya. atha khv'etaṃ, moghapurisa, appasannānañ'c'eva appasādāya, pasannānañ'ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā'ti.
aggato ve pasannānaṃ, aggaṃ dhammaṃ vijānataṃ. agge buddhe pasannānaṃ, dakkhiṇeyye anuttare.

44599.meaning1: full of devotion; mentally full of confidence (in)
44599.meaning2: having a gladdened or devoted mind
44599.commentary: (UDa) pasannacittan'ti vicikicchāvigamena sammāpaṭipattiyā adhimuttacittaṃ. (ITIa) pasannacittan'ti ratanattayasaddhāya kammaphalasaddhāya ca pasannamānasaṃ.

examples.text: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brahm'āyuṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi, dukkhaṃ, samudayaṃ, nirodhaṃ, maggaṃ.
yam'āhu dānaṃ paramaṃ anuttaraṃ, yaṃ saṃvibhāgaṃ bhagavā avaṇṇayi, aggamhi khettamhi pasannacitto, viññū pajānaṃ ko na yajetha kāle.
